mintAuthority.summary: WPEN has reviewed native issuer deployments on Ethereum, Base, Worldchain, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, Celo, and HyperEVM. On the six original deployments the shared issuer EOA retains direct MINTER_ROLE and UUPS UPGRADER_ROLE. The 4-of-7 Ripio Safe controls native roles; its Ethereum and Celo owner sets have changed since the earlier review, while HyperEVM retains the older owner set. The recorded LimitedMinter contract has native MINTER_ROLE on Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis, subject to the pinned observations in its control. The separate LimitedMinterBridge and BridgeDeposit cross-chain rail is assessed under Bridge Risk. Historical dormant-supply observations on Celo and HyperEVM are not refreshed here.

controls.label: Ripio shared WPEN admin and MINTER_ROLE holder (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) and hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) both returned true. eth_getCode returned 0x (EOA). Same role confirmed via hasRole on Base, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, and Worldchain at same block range.

controls.label: Ripio WPEN Safe multisig (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At ethereum block 26095831, Safe getOwners() returns the recorded current seven owners and getThreshold() returns 4. Ethereum and Celo now include 0xf7104ad39080c53e2c8c74a34c34e622d8abe2c5 where the prior record listed 0x067823401127ca6647481c68011805b90d42231e; HyperEVM retains that older owner. Existing native role assignments were rechecked using hasRole; historical July/September role observations are not treated as current quorum evidence.

review.evidence: Current native authority observations on 2026-10-01 retain the shared issuer EOA's MINTER_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE on the six original chains and the Safe's direct MINTER_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE on Celo and HyperEVM. Pinned reads confirm the separate native LimitedMinter contract on Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis. Ethereum and Celo Safe owners differ from the older recorded set; all reviewed Safes remain 4-of-7. Historical supply and prior role observations retain their original dates. BridgeDeposit and LimitedMinterBridge are separately assessed under Bridge Risk.
